b: I was on a call with a google rep today (I know, I know) and we were talking about timing for switching a campaign to max conv from max clicks.

I was taught years ago that you make the switch when there are 30 conversions in the past 30 days. The reps told me that it is actually when the account as a whole has 30 conversions, not when an individual campaign does.
Has anyone heard this before? More importantly, has anyone tested this and had success?
